card.name: Comma ending an interaction condition clause
card.fires_on: The comma (or closing bracket) that ends an opening 'during concomitant use of X' or 'when discontinuing X' clause, right before the instruction to monitor, taper or avoid.

modes.label: Comma after drug in condition
modes.description: Comma after a named drug or drug class in a 'during use with' or 'when discontinuing' clause.
modes.example: When discontinuing chronically administered metoprolol<<,>> particularly in patients with coronary artery disease,

modes.label: Comma after patient or reason phrase
modes.description: Comma closing a short patient-state or reason phrase before the action instruction.
modes.example: CYP3A4 Inducers Due to decreased gepotidacin exposures<<,>> avoid coadministration of BLUJEPA
